subject.title: Feature Request: Surface API provider name in error/overload messages

question: Should transient provider-failure replies show only provider/model, or also profile-presence and trigger context as proposed by the linked implementation PR?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent user-visible diagnostic boundary affects shared transports and auth/provider privacy expectations.

options.title: Provider/model only
options.body: Satisfy this issue with provider/model in user-visible overload and rate-limit copy, while keeping profile and trigger detail in logs or metadata unless separately approved.

options.title: Broader visible diagnostics
options.body: Accept provider/model plus profile-presence and trigger in channel-visible copy after refreshed-head validation and transport proof show raw private identifiers are omitted.

options.title: Metadata-only diagnostics
options.body: Keep transient chat copy generic and expose provider context only in lifecycle/log metadata, which reduces disclosure but does not solve the reported user ambiguity.

recommendation.title: Provider/model only
recommendation.body: Satisfy this issue with provider/model in user-visible overload and rate-limit copy, while keeping profile and trigger detail in logs or metadata unless separately approved.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has history on the transient-copy helper and adjacent formatter refactors, making him the best available routing candidate for the visibility-boundary decision.
